### 🍊 [没有安排的一天，反而过得最舒服](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QOFhaDA3X3Q)

|sew|缝|loose|松动的|wiggly|不平整的|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|yarn|毛线|crochet hook|钩针|prose|散文|
|taboo|禁忌的|premise|前提|granny|奶奶/外婆；婆婆妈妈的人|

- But other than that \(但除此之外\)，

- And by the way \(顺便说一句\),

- So, I wanted to do a little update on my project and show you guys what's going on\.

【闲逛】

- I'm getting ready to **head out \(出门\)**\. 

- I might **stop by \(逛\) **a few stores\.

- But I know on the weekends the line is **insane\. Like** it goes around the block\.

- But, like I said, **we'll see\(我们拭目以待\)**\. 

- So, I was **walking around Coach \(在 Coach 店里逛了一圈\)**, and there are honestly a few things that really **caught my eye \(吸引了我的目光\)**\.

- It's **kind of like an awkward vibe** \(气氛有点尴尬\)\.

- I saw a few things that I liked, but **the lines to try things on \(试穿的队伍\) **was just absolutely ridiculous, and it was not even moving at all\. Like people were totally just** stuck** there\. 

- I **had some errands to run \(我有些事情要办\)** that required me to get out of my apartment, and after I finished what I needed to do, I **stopped \(\(顺道去了\)** at a nearby bookstore \.

【兴趣】

- And if you can't tell by the background here, I'm working on a **crochet** project \(**钩针编织**项目\)\.

- I honestly really like doing this because it's a great time for me to kind of **meditate \(冥想**\), or I can clear my mind while I do something with my hands, and I feel like it's very **soothing \(舒缓\) **for me\.

【阅读】

- This is one of my favorite authors ever\. It's by Banana Yoshimoto\. It's called **The Premonition \(《预感》\)**\. And I was reading **the blurb on the back \(封底的简介\)**\.

- This sentence on the back of the book that really attracted me **goes like this \(它是这样写的\)**\. So, Yayoi, a 19\-year\-old woman from a loving \(充满爱的\) middle\-class family, has lately been **haunted \(所困扰\) **by the feeling that she has forgotten something important from her childhood\.

- They're the type of stories that** stick with you** for a really long time \(会让你长时间记住的故事\)\. They make you **contemplate **the meaning of life\.

- **And as another update,** I finished this book last night\. I'm still trying to decide how I feel about it \(我还在思考我对这件事的感受\)\. 

- **My main issue lies with \(我的问题在于\)** the relationships between some of the characters in this book\.

- I think it was just one thing I **couldn't get off of my mind \(萦绕在心头\) **while I was reading\.

- The main thing that** drew me** **in** was \.\.\. **\(最吸引我的是\.\.\.\)**

- I feel like it **gets resolved very early on \(很早就解决了\)** in the novel, and then the rest of the book is something else\. 

- But that is just my initial thought\. Maybe my feelings will change **as time goes on**\.

【喝】

- **grab** a cup of coffee

- Taste test \(口味测试\)\.

- I **feel like** the matcha is very **powdery** \(抹茶粉质很重\)\. I don't feel like **it's that high quality**, but it** suffices for a nice little drink \(但作为一杯小饮料来说也足够了\)**\. It's not the worst matcha I've ever had, so **that's a plus \(算是个优点吧\)**\. 

- Last time I got like an iced coffee from them, **I also was not that impressed**\.

【吃】

- I have changed my clothes because I don't like wearing outside clothes inside, and I just **got some takeout \(点了外卖\)**\.

- I got some **chicken tikki masala \(鸡肉咖喱块\)** and **garlic naan \(蒜蓉烤饼\)**\. And this is some **side dish \(配菜\)**\. 

- I like to just **dip it in here \(把它蘸一下\)** and **take a bite \(咬一口\)**\.

### 🍊 [Everything I Know About Love](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m51z-7TXZ4A)

> Dolly Alderton
> 
> 

|rom\-coms|浪漫喜剧|genuinely |真心地|being in a relationship|恋爱|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|main character|主角|side character|配角|get along with |处得来|
|validation|认可|horrible|糟糕的|pick up the call|接电话|
|ultimately||revolve around sb|围绕某人|be busy with|忙于|

\.\.\. , myself included, \.\.\.  包括我自己

go through really hard times 经历艰难时期

speaking from my own personal experience, \.\.\. 就我个人经验而言

But, that's not really the case \(但事实并非如此\)\.

at the end of the day 归根结底

be fulfilled in \.\.\. 在\.\.\.中获得满足感 

Don't get me wrong \(别误会我的意思\)\.

【观点】 

- But, I think **a core issue here is that \(问题的核心在于\) **when you place your own value and your self\-worth \(自我价值\) on those romantic relationships, **it tends to be **very soul\-crushing \(痛苦\) when those relationships go away \(消失\)\. 

- I think **the healthiest way to go about this** \(最健康的做法\) is to find value in yourself and to build long\-lasting non\-romantic relationships\. 

- I needed to improve myself before I **got into these relationships \(开始这些恋爱关系\)**\. And ultimately, I think that helped me a lot because I know a lot of people who got into a relationship really young, and it didn't really work out \(要么没成功\) or had a really bad ending\.

- But, I really disagree with** this kind of way of thinking \(这种想法**\)\. I don't think that the years that you spent together in the past really mean that much about the future\. **It's more about **how you guys support each other, and how do you feel when you**'re around him \(和他在一起\)**?
